description.text: The seventh Sun & Moon set, released on 3 August 2018 with 183 cards: 168 and 15 secret rares, the largest set of the series so far and the second-largest English set after Aquapolis. It joins two Japanese sets, Sky-Splitting Charisma and the nostalgic Champion Road, whose cards reuse artwork from the game's early years, such as Neo Discovery's Tyranitar. It has 11 Pokémon-GX, among them Rayquaza-GX, Articuno-GX, Blaziken-GX and the first Stakataka, Prism Star Latios, Latias and Jirachi, and Rainbow Energy.

sources.title: Wikipedia: List of Pokémon Trading Card Game sets
Flipside Gaming: Sun and Moon Celestial Storm Collector's Dossier
